correctness.rationale: Equal halves require 0 or 2 ones. For two, the midpoint must lie between the ones and their separating zero run has (b+j−i)/2 zeros to the left of it; this gives precisely the parity and band conditions, including endpoints. Each pair names a distinct string, and fixing i−j gives the stated interval intersection count. The continuum section length is piecewise linear with slopes 0 or ±1; rounding each cross-section and comparing the spacing-two sum to its integral costs O(n) uniformly. Integrating the clipped triangles gives the stated area. When b≥s/3 the rectangle bound is at most s²/9; when a or c is less than b<s/3 the rectangle bound is strictly below b(s−2b)≤s²/8. With both outer lengths at least b, the area is bs−2b²−|a−c|²/2 for |a−c|≤b, and bs−3b²/2−b|a−c| otherwise; the latter is below s²/10 for b>0, and b=0 has zero area. The unique equality case, rounding, and compactness prove the coefficient and rigidity. For (3k,2k,3k), summing 3k+1−|d| at the allowed even differences gives 4k²+3k+1, then add the unary count. The frozen verification and script were inspected, not executed.
